roadmap.title: Normal campaign, no continues, and full scanning
roadmap.description: Play Normal, reject every Continue prompt after death, scan all 30 handprints and every enemy type, open the Solarium pool, and complete the campaign combat challenges.

roadmap.title: Infernal New Game+ cleanup
roadmap.description: Carry the Normal clear's weapons and custom parts into Infernal, finish the highest difficulty, and clean up any missed campaign-only actions.

roadmap.title: Chasm foundations and co-op action
roadmap.description: Clear all 20 Chasm stages, learn the bonus rules, build early levels and gear, earn easy bonuses and S ranks, and arrange one partner session for Dynamic Duo.

roadmap.title: Trench, Abyss, levels, ranks, and bonus grind
roadmap.description: Progress through Trench and Abyss while farming EXP, BP, kills, S ranks, and at least 150 unique stage bonuses; revisit early stages after improving gear.

roadmap.title: Ghost Ship and legendary weapon cleanup
roadmap.description: Use endgame weapons and custom parts to clear The Ghost Ship, then keep opening weapon cases until Pale Rider, Drake, and Muramasa are all owned.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Campaign Episodes 1–3} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This story milestone unlocks automatically after the third episode; no optional objective affects it.

steps.text: Play the campaign through the end of Episode 3 and continue past the results screen.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Campaign Episodes 4–6} on any difficulty.

guide.context: The award follows the campaign's second three-episode block and cannot be missed while advancing the story.

steps.text: Continue the campaign through the end of Episode 6 and pass its results screen.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Campaign Episodes 7–9} on any difficulty.

guide.context: This is an automatic campaign-progress award with no rank or difficulty requirement.

steps.text: Finish Episode 9 and advance beyond the episode results.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Campaign Episodes 10–12} on any difficulty.

guide.context: Episode 12 is the campaign finale, so this milestone arrives with a completed story run.

steps.text: Defeat the final boss, complete Episode 12, and continue through the ending results.

achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on @mechanic{Casual difficulty or higher}.

guide.context: Difficulty awards stack upward, so the planned Normal clear also satisfies the Casual threshold.

steps.text: Start the first campaign on Normal and finish all 12 episodes to unlock both Casual- and Normal-tier clear achievements.

achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on @mechanic{Normal difficulty or higher}.

guide.context: A Normal first run provides clear data, weapons, and custom parts for the later Infernal New Game+ run.

steps.text: Select Normal at New Game, complete Episodes 1–12, and save the resulting clear data.

achievements.summary: Finish all 12 campaign episodes on @mechanic{Infernal difficulty}.

guide.context: Infernal is designed for a later playthrough; New Game+ retains the weapons and custom parts from the selected clear save.

steps.text: Choose New Game+, select the completed Normal save, and set the new run to Infernal.
Use the carried equipment to complete all 12 episodes and defeat Norman on Infernal.

achievements.description: 【CAMPAIGN】Clear the game in Normal difficulty or above without dying once.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on @mechanic{Normal or Infernal} without accepting a continue after any death.

guide.context: The run is invalidated by choosing `Yes` at the `Continue?` prompt; reloading without accepting the continue preserves the no-death condition.

steps.text: Begin a Normal campaign and keep a current save or checkpoint available.
Whenever Jill dies, select `No` at `Continue?`, return to the title or campaign menu, and reload instead of resuming through the prompt.
Complete Episode 12 without ever accepting a post-death continue.

achievements.summary: Scan one hidden @item{handprint} with the Genesis scanner during the campaign.

guide.context: Handprints are invisible until viewed through the Genesis scanner, and scanned prints stay credited on New Game+.

steps.text: In Episode 1 after the beach tunnel, aim the Genesis scanner at the FBC container on the right and hold the scan until the handprint registers.

achievements.summary: Scan 15 distinct hidden @item{handprints} with the Genesis scanner during campaign play.

guide.context: Collected handprints persist into New Game+, so the total can span runs even though the game has no checklist.

achievements.description: 【CAMPAIGN】Scan an enemy for the first time.
achievements.summary: Complete one Genesis scan of any campaign @enemy{enemy}.

guide.context: Living and dead targets can be scanned when the reticle permits, but dissolving enemies must be scanned before their bodies vanish.

steps.text: Equip the Genesis scanner, center any early Ooze in the reticle, and hold the scan input until progress reaches 100%.

achievements.summary: Use the Genesis scanner to register all 18 campaign @enemy{enemy types}.

guide.context: There is no in-game enemy checklist. Fast-dissolving enemies and the Malacoda arm are easy to miss, so mark each type off when its scan reaches 100%.

achievements.summary: Defeat 150 @enemy{enemies} during campaign play.

guide.context: The total accumulates across normal combat and requires no particular enemy type or weapon.

steps.text: Kill enemies instead of bypassing most encounters; the cumulative 150th campaign kill awards the achievement.

achievements.description: 【CAMPAIGN】Stop an enemy bullet with your knife.
achievements.summary: Destroy a @enemy{Tricorne Ooze projectile} with the knife before the shot hits Jill.

guide.context: A lone Tricorne makes the timing safer because no other enemy can interrupt the setup.

steps.text: Kill nearby enemies and leave one Tricorne Ooze alive at medium range.
Watch the Tricorne launch its ranged projectile, face the shot, and swing the knife as the projectile reaches Jill.

achievements.description: 【CAMPAIGN】Defeat Rachael before she gets to the cafeteria.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Rachael Ooze} during the Episode 4 pursuit before she reaches the @loc{Cafeteria}.

guide.context: Rachael retreats through vents several times; every early encounter is a damage window, and New Game+ firepower shortens the pursuit.

steps.text: Bring the strongest rifle or magnum with damage custom parts plus pulse or decoy grenades.
At each vent appearance, stun Rachael with a pulse or decoy grenade and keep firing at her before she escapes again.
Deal enough cumulative damage to kill Rachael before she crosses into the Cafeteria.

achievements.summary: Kill 10 @enemy{Ooze-family enemies} with a headshot as the final hit.

guide.context: Standard, Pincer, and Tricorne Oozes all qualify; only the killing bullet must strike the head.

steps.text: Damage an Ooze until it is near death, then aim at the head.
Deliver the final bullet to the head and repeat across campaign encounters until 10 headshot kills register.

achievements.summary: Dodge a @enemy{Scagdead's instant-kill attack} during a campaign encounter.

guide.context: The Communications Officer fight and Chris's Casino fight both provide attempts at the required close-range attack.

steps.text: Stay near a Scagdead until it begins the instant-kill chainsaw or grab animation.
Press the configured forward input—`W` on the default PC keyboard controls—as the attack lands so Jill performs the evasive animation.

achievements.summary: Kill three @enemy{Ghiozzo} at once with a single @item{shock grenade} in the Bilge.

guide.context: Ghiozzo cluster tightly while swimming, giving the shock grenade enough targets and bonus damage in water.

steps.text: In a Bilge water section, wait until at least three Ghiozzo are swimming close together.
Throw one shock grenade into the center of the school and ensure the same blast kills three fish.

achievements.description: 【CAMPAIGN】Defeat a Scarmiglione as a whole without killing both parts of its body separately.
achievements.summary: Kill an intact @enemy{Scarmiglione} before its torso and legs separate.

guide.context: The tall armored enemies appear in the Laboratory and can split when damaged unevenly; a fast, high-damage opening avoids that transition.

steps.text: On Normal or New Game+, equip a high-damage rifle or magnum.
Fire into the Scarmiglione's head before it raises its shield and continue concentrated damage until the whole body dies together.

achievements.description: 【CAMPAIGN】Defeat a Malacoda without using a rocket launcher.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Malacoda} without firing the helicopter's @item{Rocket Launcher}.

guide.context: The helicopter supplies a Rocket Launcher during the battle, but a prepared New Game+ loadout can finish the boss without it.

steps.text: Enter the deck battle with a rifle or magnum and an AUG or G36 with strong damage parts.
When the helicopter drops the Rocket Launcher crate, leave the launcher unused.
Keep shooting Malacoda's parasite arms with carried weapons until enough arms die and the boss fight ends.

achievements.summary: Activate the @loc{Solarium} filtration system in Episode 3, then return and swim in the cleaned pool during Episode 4.

guide.context: The water does not become swimmable during the first visit; filtration needs story time to finish between episodes.

steps.text: In Episode 3, climb to the Grand Hall's upper floor, enter the door labeled `Solarium`, and activate the panel in the only side room.
In Episode 4, revisit the Solarium after the filtration cycle has cleaned the water.
Enter the pool and swim until the achievement registers.

achievements.summary: Perform 20 successful dodges against @enemy{enemy attacks} during the campaign.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, and a dodge counts only when the character performs the actual evasive animation.

steps.text: Face a predictable melee enemy, wait for its attack tell, and press forward plus the interaction input at the impact moment.
Continue landing successful dodge animations across encounters until the 20th dodge registers.

achievements.summary: Land 10 fully charged @mechanic{physical attacks} on staggered campaign enemies.

guide.context: Shooting both arms of a non-Tricorne Ooze is a reliable way to create the stagger that enables a physical-attack prompt.

steps.text: Shoot both arms of a standard or Pincer Ooze until the enemy staggers.
Approach the staggered enemy, hold the displayed physical-attack input until the charge completes, and let the attack connect.
Repeat the full stagger-and-charge sequence until 10 charged hits have landed.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear all stages in Raid mode on Chasm.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 @mechanic{Chasm} stages in Raid Mode with any rank.

guide.context: Campaign Episodes 1–12 progressively unlock Chasm stages 1–20; The Ghost Ship is not part of this set.

steps.text: Finish the campaign so every Chasm stage is available.
Complete Chasm stages 1 through 20; any completion rank counts.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear all stages in Raid mode on Trench.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 @mechanic{Trench} stages in Raid Mode with any rank.

guide.context: Trench opens after Chasm Stage 20, and each completed Trench stage unlocks the next one.

steps.text: Clear all Chasm stages, including Chasm Stage 20, to open Trench.
Progress through and complete Trench stages 1–20 with any rank.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear all stages in Raid mode on Abyss.
achievements.summary: Clear all 20 @mechanic{Abyss} stages in Raid Mode with any rank.

guide.context: Abyss is the hardest standard tier and opens after Trench Stage 20; late stages expect level 46+ weapons and substantial upgrades.

steps.text: Clear Trench Stage 20 to unlock Abyss Stage 1.
Complete Abyss stages in order, farming levels, BP, weapons, and parts whenever the next stage blocks progress.
Clear Abyss Stage 20 to complete the 20-stage set.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear all stages in Raid mode on Chasm with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{S rank} on all 20 Chasm stages in Raid Mode.

guide.context: Rank favors accuracy, low damage, and speed; a Trinity clear guarantees S rank, while overleveling makes ordinary Chasm cleanup easy.

steps.text: Reach about player level 30 or higher and equip weapons near the active level.
Revisit every Chasm stage, finish quickly, avoid damage and wasted shots, and replay any stage whose result is below S.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear all stages in Raid mode on Trench with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{S rank} on all 20 Trench stages in Raid Mode.

guide.context: By player level 46, the active level is more than 10 above every Trench recommendation, making rank cleanup much safer.

steps.text: Reach player level 46 and equip upgraded level-appropriate weapons.
Clear each Trench stage quickly with high accuracy and limited damage, replaying stages until all 20 show S rank.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear all stages in Raid mode on Abyss with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{S rank} on all 20 Abyss stages in Raid Mode.

guide.context: Abyss ranks are late-game work; route knowledge, level 46–50 weapons, and permanent upgrades matter more than early retries.

steps.text: Reach player level 50, clear the Abyss route, and build a strong set of level 46+ weapons.
Replay every Abyss stage with a fast route, high accuracy, few hits, and enough kills to improve the result.
Check the stage list and continue until all 20 Abyss entries display S rank.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear the bonus stage, The Ghost Ship.
achievements.summary: Complete the Raid Mode bonus stage @loc{The Ghost Ship}.

guide.context: Episode 12 unlocks The Ghost Ship, but its enemies and final waves make it endgame content. Selecting player level 49 avoids the extra final boss wave triggered at level 50.

steps.text: Build level 46–50 weapons with damage, ammunition, and sustain parts, buy all useful armor and pouch upgrades, and bring a partner if available.
Set the active character to player level 49 before starting The Ghost Ship.
Follow a practiced route, conserve boss-killing ammunition for the deck waves, defeat the final enemies, and break the completion emblem.

achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{player level 5} in Raid Mode.

guide.context: Raid EXP is saved after every stage attempt, but successful clears award more than retirement or death.

steps.text: Clear early Chasm stages until the post-stage EXP raises the Raid player level to 5.

achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{player level 10} in Raid Mode.

guide.context: Bonuses increase EXP payouts, so early No Damage and Genocide clears accelerate leveling.

steps.text: Continue clearing Chasm stages and earning bonuses until the Raid player level reaches 10.

achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{player level 20} in Raid Mode.

guide.context: A full pass through Chasm stages 1–20 normally places a new Raid character near level 20.

steps.text: Progress through all 20 Chasm stages and replay profitable early stages until the Raid player level reaches 20.

achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{player level 30} in Raid Mode.

guide.context: Trench progression and repeated bonus clears provide the EXP needed beyond the natural Chasm curve.

steps.text: Clear Trench stages while farming Chasm 12 or Chasm 20 for resources and EXP until the player level reaches 30.

achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{player level 40} in Raid Mode.

guide.context: Chasm 20 gives fast EXP and supplies, while Abyss 1 becomes the stronger EXP farm after Trinity clears are consistent.

steps.text: Alternate new Abyss clears with repeated Chasm 20 or Abyss 1 bonus runs until the Raid player level reaches 40.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum @mechanic{player level 50} in Raid Mode.

guide.context: Successful clears and bonuses award the most EXP. A repeatable Abyss Stage 1 Trinity route is a strong late-game farm.

steps.text: Complete as many Abyss stages as current equipment allows.
When progression stalls, repeat Chasm 20 for Genocide and No Damage or Abyss 1 for Trinity, then improve weapons and resume Abyss.
Continue successful stage clears until the results screen raises the player level to 50.

achievements.summary: Personally defeat 10,000 @enemy{enemies} in Raid Mode.

guide.context: A co-op partner's kills do not count. RE.NET combines campaign and Raid kills, so only continued Raid kills can resolve a total that appears high enough externally.

steps.text: Progress through all Raid tiers while personally taking as many kills as possible.
After other objectives are complete, repeat a fast enemy-dense stage and personally land every finishing blow until the Raid-only total reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Inflict 100,000 points of damage to an enemy in one hit.
achievements.summary: Deal at least 100,000 damage to one @enemy{enemy} with a single Raid Mode hit.

guide.context: A store-bought Rocket Launcher supplies enough one-hit damage without waiting for a perfectly upgraded conventional weapon.

steps.text: Purchase a Rocket Launcher from the Raid Mode store.
Start a high-level stage containing a durable boss enemy.
Aim the Rocket Launcher directly at the boss and land one hit for at least 100,000 displayed damage.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Land a fully charged physical attack on an enemy at the same time as your partner.
achievements.summary: In online Raid Mode, have both players land fully charged @mechanic{physical attacks} on the same staggered enemy at the same time.

guide.context: This is the only achievement that requires another human player. Prefer Private Match with a trusted Steam friend because current community reports warn that unknown public hosts may run mods that replace local core game files.

steps.text: Use Private Match to enter a low-level Raid stage with a trusted Steam friend.
Damage a durable enemy's weak points until the physical-attack prompt appears.
Stand beside the same staggered enemy, have both players hold the physical-attack input to full charge, and release together so both hits connect simultaneously.

achievements.summary: Obtain any one super-rare Raid weapon: @item{Pale Rider}, @item{Drake}, or @item{Muramasa}.

guide.context: Super-rare weapons can emerge from identified weapon cases, while Pale Rider can also rotate into the in-game store.

steps.text: Pick up weapon cases during Raid stages and complete or retire from the stage so their contents are identified.
Continue opening cases or checking the store until Pale Rider, Drake, or Muramasa enters the weapon inventory.

achievements.summary: Own @item{Pale Rider}, @item{Drake}, and @item{Muramasa} together in the Raid weapon inventory.

guide.context: All three super-rare models are random case rewards except that Pale Rider can also appear in the store; selling a unique model removes it from the owned set.

steps.text: Retain every Pale Rider, Drake, and Muramasa instead of selling the only copy.
Farm weapon cases from the highest Raid stages that can be completed or safely retired from.
Identify cases after each run until all three named weapon models are present at the same time.

achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative 1,000,000 @mechanic{BP} in the Raid Mode store.

guide.context: The threshold counts useful purchases across the full Raid progression, so armor, ammunition pouches, weapons, refills, and permanent upgrades all advance it.

steps.text: Prioritize every armor and ammunition-pouch upgrade, then replace underleveled weapons as Raid progression advances.
Use later BP on consumable refills and permanent upgrades until total store spending reaches 1,000,000 BP.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Acquire No Damage Bonus for the first time.
achievements.summary: Finish one Raid Mode stage without taking damage to earn a @mechanic{No Damage bonus}.

guide.context: The bonus checks the entire run; Chasm Stage 1 has the shortest and safest early enemy route.

steps.text: Select Chasm Stage 1 with the highest available player level and a strong accurate weapon.
Kill every threat before it can connect, take no environmental or enemy damage, and break the completion emblem.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Clear a stage at 5 levels lower than the recommended level.
achievements.summary: Clear a Raid stage while the active player level is at least five below the stage's recommended level.

guide.context: The Character Selection screen can lower the active level without erasing earned levels, allowing this condition after normal progression.

steps.text: In Character Selection, set the active player level to exactly five below an early Chasm stage's recommended level.
Use weapons at or below the adjusted active level to avoid the over-level weapon penalty.
Complete the selected stage and break its ending emblem at the lowered level.

achievements.description: 【RAID MODE】Acquire Trinity Bonus for the first time.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{Low Level}, @mechanic{Genocide}, and @mechanic{No Damage} in the same Raid-stage run to receive Trinity.

guide.context: Low Level allows an active level equal to the recommendation. In co-op, a partner taking damage does not invalidate the achievement hunter's No Damage bonus.

steps.text: Choose Chasm Stage 1 and set the active player level at or below its recommendation.
Trigger and kill every enemy, take no damage, and complete the stage without raising the active level.
On the results screen, confirm Low Level, Genocide, No Damage, and the resulting Trinity bonus all appear.

achievements.summary: Record 10 unique Raid-stage bonuses across @mechanic{Low Level}, @mechanic{Genocide}, @mechanic{No Damage}, and @mechanic{Trinity}.

guide.context: Each bonus is stored once per stage and difficulty; repeating an already recorded icon does not add another unique bonus.

steps.text: Clear early Chasm stages thoroughly and without damage, then lower the active level for Low Level and Trinity attempts until 10 blue bonus icons are recorded.

achievements.summary: Record 50 unique Raid-stage bonuses across all stage and difficulty combinations.

guide.context: Overleveling makes Genocide and No Damage easy on Chasm, while lowering the active level later recovers Low Level and Trinity on those same stages.

steps.text: Earn Genocide and No Damage broadly across Chasm stages, then lower the active level for early-stage Low Level and Trinity clears.
Add Trench bonuses as progression opens until the stage list shows at least 50 recorded blue icons.

achievements.summary: Record 100 unique Raid-stage bonuses across Chasm, Trench, Abyss, and The Ghost Ship.

guide.context: Each standard difficulty contains 80 possible bonuses, so the target can be reached without forcing the hardest Abyss Trinity clears.

steps.text: Collect most Chasm Genocide, No Damage, Low Level, and practical Trinity bonuses.
Add Trench Genocide, Low Level, and manageable No Damage bonuses until the unique total reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Record 150 unique Raid-stage bonuses from the 244 available across all Raid content.

guide.context: The four blue icons count separately once per stage and difficulty. Lowering the active player level lets a level-50 character revisit early stages for Low Level and Trinity.

steps.text: Earn Genocide, No Damage, and Low Level on all 20 Chasm stages, then add Trinity on Chasm 1–5, 8, 11–15, and 19 for a 72-bonus subtotal.
Earn Genocide on all 20 Trench stages and Low Level on Trench 1–19; add No Damage on Trench 1–8, 11, 13–15, and 19 for 52 more bonuses.
Earn Genocide on Abyss 1–12, then add Trench 20 Low Level; Abyss 14–17, 19, and 20 Genocide; Low Level, No Damage, and Trinity on Abyss 1; and The Ghost Ship's Low Level bonus.

After the main route reaches 147, take any three of these named gaps: Trench Stage 12 No Damage; Trench stages 1, 3, or 5 Trinity; Abyss stages 13 or 18 Genocide; or Abyss Stage 3 Low Level or No Damage.
Count the blue icons in the stage lists and continue until 150 distinct bonuses are recorded.
